shared_elements: banded or register-like organization of carved signs
justification: The most specific shared content is the use of repeated chevron/zigzag bands and short parallel bar-like signs as part of a carved linear sign system. The major difference is that A is dominated by a central oval enclosure filled with abstract signs and flanked by symmetrical vertical pattern bands, while B shows profile animals and human/creature figures arranged in horizontal registers with only some patterned bands.
